title: 忄 / 心 heart (竖心旁 / 心字底)
intro: The heart radical has two forms. On the left it is 忄: write the left dot, the right dot, then the vertical. At the bottom it is the full 心. Both mark feelings, thoughts and states of mind.

ex.zh: 我最近很忙，没时间去看你。
ex.p: wǒ zuì jìn hěn máng méi shí jiān qù kàn nǐ
ex.en: I've been busy lately, and haven't had time to visit you.

ex.p: nǐ néng bāng wǒ yī gè máng ma
ex.en: Can you do me a favor?

ex.zh: 你说得太快了，请说慢一点儿。
ex.p: nǐ shuō de tài kuài le qǐng shuō màn yī diǎnr
ex.en: You're talking too fast, please speak more slowly.

ex.p: zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè
ex.en: Happy birthday!

ex.p: kuài xià yǔ le wǒ men kuài zǒu ba
ex.en: It's about to rain, let's hurry.

ex.zh: 你说得太快了，请说慢一点儿。
ex.p: nǐ shuō de tài kuài le qǐng shuō màn yī diǎnr
ex.en: You're talking too fast, please speak more slowly.

ex.p: bié zháo jí màn màn lái
ex.en: Don't worry, take your time.

ex.p: tā jīn tiān xīn qíng bù tài hǎo
ex.en: He's not in a great mood today.

ex.zh: 学汉字是一件很有意思的事情。
ex.p: xué hàn zì shì yī jiàn hěn yǒu yì si de shì qing
ex.en: Learning characters is a very interesting thing.

ex.zh: 我怕忘了，所以写下来了。
ex.p: wǒ pà wàng le suǒ yǐ xiě xià lai le
ex.en: I was afraid I'd forget, so I wrote it down.

ex.p: wǒ pà gǒu
ex.en: I'm afraid of dogs.

ex.p: wǒ bù dǒng zhè gè cí de yì si
ex.en: I don't understand what this word means.

ex.p: nǐ yǐn dǒng le ma
ex.en: Did you understand (what you heard)?

ex.zh: 你习惯这里的生活了吗？
ex.p: nǐ xí guàn zhè lǐ de shēng huó le ma
ex.en: Have you gotten used to life here?

ex.zh: 他每天早上跑步，已经习惯了。
ex.p: tā měi tiān zǎo shang pǎo bù yǐ jīng xí guàn le
ex.en: He runs every morning, he's used to it now.

ex.p: wǒ hěn xiǎng jiā
ex.en: I miss home a lot.

ex.p: nǐ zěn me xiǎng
ex.en: What do you think?

ex.p: wǒ bù dǒng zhè gè cí de yì si
ex.en: I don't understand what this word means.

ex.p: zhè gè diàn yǐng hěn yǒu yì si
ex.en: This movie is very interesting.

ex.zh: 学汉字是一件很有意思的事情。
ex.p: xué hàn zì shì yī jiàn hěn yǒu yì si de shì qing
ex.en: Learning characters is a very interesting thing.

ex.zh: 我感冒了，感觉很不舒服。
ex.p: wǒ gǎn mào le gǎn jué hěn bù shū fu
ex.en: I have a cold and feel awful.

ex.zh: 我怕忘了，所以写下来了。
ex.p: wǒ pà wàng le suǒ yǐ xiě xià lai le
ex.en: I was afraid I'd forget, so I wrote it down.

ex.p: wǒ wàng le tā de míng zi
ex.en: I forgot his name.

ex.p: bié zháo jí màn màn lái
ex.en: Don't worry, take your time.

ex.p: wǒ yǒu jí shì xiān zǒu le
ex.en: I have something urgent, I'm heading off first.

texts.title: 读一读 · 忄 / 心 heart (竖心旁 / 心字底)

lines.p: wǒ lái zhōng guó sān gè yuè le

lines.zh: 刚来的时候，我听不懂中国人说话，因为他们说得太快了。
lines.p: gāng lái de shí hou wǒ yǐn bù dǒng zhōng guó rén shuō huà yīn wèi tā men shuō de tài kuài le

lines.zh: 我很想家，心情也不太好。
lines.p: wǒ hěn xiǎng jiā xīn qíng yě bù tài hǎo

lines.zh: 现在我已经习惯了这里的生活，也交了很多朋友。
lines.p: xiàn zài wǒ yǐ jīng xí guàn le zhè lǐ de shēng huó yě jiāo le hěn duō péng you

lines.zh: 学汉语虽然很忙，但是很有意思。
lines.p: xué hàn yǔ suī rán hěn máng dàn shì hěn yǒu yì si

qs.q: 刚来的时候“我”为什么听不懂？

exercises.why: Same parts: 忄 on the left = busy; 心 at the bottom = forget
董 is only the sound part
拍 (clap) has 扌; fear has 忄

exercises.q: 你习贯这里的生活了吗？
exercises.ans: 你习惯这里的生活了吗？
exercises.why: 贯 is only the sound part
